fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) requires a 57.8% increase by 2027 to achieve a target price of $600, while the current Wall Street average target price is $412.48 (8.5% upside from current price of $380.11).
fields.summary_ko.1: FSD subscription service subscribers reached 1.74 million, up 67% from 1.04 million a year ago, but Q3 operating profit declined 55.79% to $718 million as R&D expenses increased from $163 million to $276 million.
fields.summary_ko.2: 2027 EPS consensus estimate stands at $2.1592, expecting 25% growth versus 2026's $1.7242; however, consensus has been revised downward from $2.2520 over the past 90 days, requiring upward estimate revisions as a prerequisite for strong outlook.
